verdict.rationale: Daily's pricing page says sign-up is free and every customer gets 10,000 free participant minutes plus support. That is a first-party free allowance suited to development and early testing. Community comments about high costs at B2C scale concern production volume, not the free allowance. Missing for 10: whether the 10,000 minutes reset monthly or are one-time, which add-on features (recording, transcription, PSTN) the free minutes cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the allowance is enough for early testing.

support.subject: As a founder, a free tier or free usage allowance covers development and early testing

citations.quote: We provide 10,000 free participant minutes and support to every customer.
